messages:
maria_cs: Quick note — during BrightFit's onboarding call today they gave a short list of pain points & feature asks. Pasting raw capture below so PM/eng can triage.

maria_cs: 1) Admin UI: onboarding CSV import fails silently for rows with extra commas — user thought upload "worked" but some accounts missing. 

maria_cs: 2) Webhooks: need delivery retries backoff + DLQ. Right now any 5xx drops events and their downstream syncs get out-of-date during bulk syncs.

maria_cs: 3) Role-based access: they want a Manager role that can see usage metrics but not billing. Current roles too coarse.

maria_cs: 4) Per-route cost attribution: they asked if we can show token cost per inbound route (similar to what Support asked); helps their finance team.

maria_cs: 5) Small UX: modal that confirms "apply changes to existing users? y/n" when editing team defaults. They hit accidental global changes.

alex_pm: thanks — super helpful capture. can you add which of these are actual blockers for launch vs nice-to-have?

maria_cs: blockers: import CSV bug (blocks migrating historical accounts), webhook DLQ (blocks real-time sync for 2 customers), role request = nice-to-have for now but called out as high priority by their security lead. rest = nice-to-have.

jon_eng: CSV import failing silently — can you paste the error logs or the sample file? i can reproduce quickly if we have it.

maria_cs: attaching sample in the ticket, but raw line they pasted: "John Doe, Acme, \"Widgets, Inc\" ,john@acme.com" — i think our CSV parser is splitting on commas inside quotes incorrectly.

jon_eng: yep that looks like CSV quoting hole. i can put a quick validation + warning in the importer in a PR (non-blocking) and will schedule deeper parser fix next sprint. estimated: validation change by EOD, full fix in 2 sprints.

emily_support: webhook DLQ — current behavior: we retry 3x then mark as failed and drop. feedback-bot: see recent webhook failures for brightfit-prod (ticket #BF-423).

feedback-bot: new ticket created: BF-423 — BrightFit webhook delivery failures during bulk sync.

alex_pm: good. let's do this triage: (A) CSV import validation patch (ship quick win) (B) webhook DLQ backlog + retry policy (medium) (C) role-based access (evaluate scope) (D) per-route cost telemetry (research feasibility) (E) confirm UX modal change.

dave_data: per-route cost: we have route tagging in telemetry, but we don't aggregate token-USD per route in Console. i can prototype an aggregation query; will need to estimate cost impact for retention.

alex_pm: assign owners? jon -> CSV + webhook retry design (coordinate with eng-sre); dave -> per-route cost prototype; maria -> follow up with BrightFit clarifying security ask; emily -> confirm support playbook for webhook retries & customer-facing guidance.

maria_cs: on it — I'll DM BrightFit to clarify which accounts were missing after import and confirm security lead availability. Will update ticket BF-423 with sample file and timeline.

jon_eng: tagging @eng-sre is good for DLQ patterns. i'll post a short design doc tomorrow.

emily_support: adding a temporary runbook: if webhook failures spike, contact BrightFit CSM and enable slow-mode batching (manual) to avoid data drift.

alex_pm: thanks everyone. i'll make a short PRio card and add to next sprint grooming. if anything changes ping here. :thumbsup:
